Where to rent: what actually fits

Almost every car rental agency will take a booking with your email and a credit card. The ones that ask for tax or bank numbers up front are usually corporate accounts with automatic tax handling — those are the ones I mark needs-tax-info below.

Budget / Avis (no tax/bank upfront)

https://www.budget.com?pid=ozarkprepper

— no tax/bank upfront

Small-budget agencies and national chains. Takes an email + credit card. If you do not want to give your tax or bank details, book with Budget or a local agency instead.

Enterprise / Hertz — needs-tax-info

Corporate accounts. You start with your email, but they pull tax and deposit info automatically. If you do not want to give that, pick the first link instead.

Affiliate links on this page: the rental links above are clearly labelled partner links — I may earn a small commission at no cost to you.

How to rent cheap: compare daily rates on more than one site before you book, and check for extra fees (young driver, mileage, fuel). A one-week rental usually costs less per day than a one-day rental.
